name: @unifedev/thread-pages
description: Thread Pages for bb: every agent session gets one directly editable HTML page you can read and answer from, on any device. The bb host of Unife Pages.
author: Bartosz

bb.name: Thread Pages
bb.description: Gives every agent session a web page it writes for its task, and lets you answer from that page instead of chat. Each page is built for the task at hand: a diagram you click, a decision sheet, a report that shows what failed. Your choices and notes on the page arrive as the agent's next message, from bb or from your phone. A home page lists your sessions by what needs you and by workspace. Pages run sandboxed with no bb credentials, and anything that touches another session asks you first.
